note: Edwards County KS parcels are distributed through the state ORKA portal (PORKA): registration/login, county approval, password-protected download, some fees. The ORKA county viewer is behind an Open Records Act click-through and exposes no public parcel REST service. ORKA services at services.kansasgis.org and services.kgs.ku.edu contain only subdivision, lot, address-point and tile-index layers, not Edwards parcels. Other sources are commercial vendors (Regrid, DynamoSpatial, Acres, Rockford Map, Equator), not county-published services. The county appraiser site was unreachable.
